description.value:
Whether you work on vidgames or holovid entertainment, you're part of the creative team that illustrates entertainment that inspires the galaxy. Whether you use traditional methods supplemented with specialty software or are all-in on the latest in computer-generated animation, you use years of training to turn storyboards and character designs into stunning visuals.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Computers skill and the Media Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Hologram Skeptic] skill feat.
